next.reason: 1985 format 3 (DIVIDE identifier-1 BY identifier-2 GIVING identifier-3): the first operand is divided by the second, stored in each identifier-3. The 2023 format 3 (§2023:14.9.12.2) names the first operand identifier-2 and the BY operand identifier-1, and §2023:14.9.12.4 GR2 'The dividend is identifier-2 or literal-2. The divisor is identifier-1 or literal-1.', so the written order means the same; §2023:14.9.12.4 GR1 forms the quotient, §2023:14.9.12.4 GR5 stores it 'in each identifier-3' per §2023:14.7.7 GR4.
